description: SSOT for anti-template / GPT-ish phrase diagnostics. Two tiers with different force. hardBan: phrases that must NEVER appear in character output — acceptance requires zero hits (currently only 接住 and its variants). candidate: suspected model-speak that is COUNTED and human-reviewed, NOT auto-banned; a candidate phrase is promoted to hardBan only once confirmed as clearly stable GPT-speak against the corpus. Read only via lib/gptish.mjs. Keep this list in sync with FAILURE_TAXONOMY.md (ERR_JIEZHU / ERR_GPTISH_PHRASE).
notes: 接住 is listed both as its specific collocations and as the bare token so any use in character output is caught (接住你的情绪 / 有人接住 / 把你接住 / 被稳稳接住 / bare 接住). The candidate list is diagnostic: hits are reported and compared to the corpus, they do not by themselves fail a candidate.
